scope: selected local heritage and trail nodes
objective: Close the authoritative-geometry and technical QA gaps left by Batch 03 without promoting tourism-map positions or inferred coordinates into canonical Atlas geometry.
authoritative_source_order: IDE Chile / competent public geospatial service
MOP Direccion de Vialidad for roads
DIRECTEMAR / SHOA where maritime geometry is authoritative
CONAF or competent protected-area authority where applicable
other Chilean public producer with explicit layer provenance

service_policy.arcgis_feature_service: acceptable_if_first-party public producer and layer metadata are explicit
service_policy.geojson: acceptable_if first-party public producer and dataset provenance are explicit

initial_official_findings.subject: ide_chile_service_capability
initial_official_findings.statement: IDE Chile documents publication and consumption of WMS, WFS, ArcGIS REST and GeoJSON services; WFS is the preferred path for authoritative feature-level extraction when an appropriate public layer is identified.

initial_official_findings.subject: ruta_y905
initial_official_findings.statement: MOP planning material continues to identify Reposicion Ruta Y-905, Williams - Navarino, reinforcing the stable route identity while geometry extraction still requires an authoritative vector layer or equivalent feature-level source.

initial_official_findings.subject: caleta_eugenia_puerto_toro
initial_official_findings.statement: Direccion de Vialidad reported in December 2025 a definitive project for an approximately 37 km penetration road between Caleta Eugenia and Puerto Toro. This is project geometry/context and must not be modeled as an already completed continuous public road.

prohibited_actions: Do not manually copy coordinates from Google Maps or tourism maps into canonical Atlas data.
Do not infer a full road line from endpoints.
Do not treat WMS pixels as canonical feature geometry without explicit feature provenance.
Do not promote planned road alignments as completed roads.
Do not merge geographic Cabo de Hornos and administrative comuna Cabo de Hornos into one geometry without explicit entity typing.

technical_followup.embedding_readiness: apply stable/dynamic/planned classification at chunk level after provenance is attached
technical_followup.merge_gate: no geometry becomes atlas-ready until producer, layer, CRS, geometry type and retrieval provenance are captured
